changes: Separated the observed monthly yield change from the registered outcome-category mapping.
Reduced the expected-policy-to-yield mechanism to background_hypothesis because the supplied evidence does not directly identify that causal effect.
Retained hawkish Fed communication as an explicit counteracting branch instead of forcing it into the realized direction.
Replaced deterministic causal wording with contributes_to or supports where competing market forces remain possible.
caveats: The expected-policy-to-two-year-yield transmission is financially plausible but only indirectly supported by the supplied evidence.
The graph explains a candidate mechanism and counter-signal; it does not claim that the included factors exhaustively caused the monthly move.
